args.rationale: Applying Verdana Compensation Authority Policy v3.2 tiered approval framework to the Chen-Velasco SVP counterproposal. Within-CPO items (base salary +3.5%, target bonus +13.9%, initial equity grant +10.0%, all under the 25% deviation threshold) fall within CPO authority under CAP §4.1. However, four items exceed CPO authority and require escalation: (1) guaranteed bonus floor (Years 1-2, $363,000 total) is categorically prohibited under CAP — a structural policy override requiring Board Compensation Committee approval; (2) CIC severance multiplier 2.0× vs 1.0× (+100%) independently exceeds the 25% threshold under CAP §4.3 requiring Committee approval; (3) CIC double-trigger equity acceleration 100% vs 50% (+100%) exceeds the 25% threshold requiring Committee approval (with GC co-approval for 280G/securities risk); (4) non-CIC severance 12 vs 9 months (+38%) exceeds the 25% threshold requiring Committee approval. Because multiple tiers are triggered (CPO, GC co-approval, and Committee) and the out-of-policy deviations independently exceed the 25% percentage threshold and include a structural policy override, the highest governing tier is the Board Compensation Committee, which must authorize this arrangement per Article 4.
